title: Show date as text in compact mode
line: The Calendar widget can now show the date as text in the panel instead of its icon.
explanation: The Calendar widget's compact version always drew the calendar icon, with only the day of the month or the week number inside it, so it couldn't be used as a plain date display next to or instead of the Digital Clock. The maintainer agreed in the bug that the compact version should be able to show the full date. The change adds a third "Show date as text" choice under Compact version: in a horizontal panel the widget shows the locale's long date without the weekday (the same text as its tooltip), in a vertical panel the short date scaled to fit the width, and on the desktop the long date fitted to the widget's size.

commits.message:
applets/calendar: add an option to show the date as text

The compact version of the Calendar widget could only show the day of
the month or the week number inside its icon. A new "Show date as text"
option replaces the icon with the date, which fits horizontal panels.

BUG: 365640

patches.diff:
From d1fa7ea040dbdad8d8e46f25c79d9eab8f35fbbb Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 22:56:00 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/calendar: add an option to show the date as text

The compact version of the Calendar widget could only show the day of
the month or the week number inside its icon. A new "Show date as text"
option replaces the icon with the date, which fits horizontal panels.

BUG: 365640
---
 applets/calendar/qml/configGeneral.qml |  6 +++++
 applets/calendar/qml/main.qml          | 37 ++++++++++++++++++++++++--
 2 files changed, 41 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/calendar/qml/configGeneral.qml b/applets/calendar/qml/configGeneral.qml
index cb28a67bc8..643a53587d 100644
--- a/applets/calendar/qml/configGeneral.qml
+++ b/applets/calendar/qml/configGeneral.qml
@@ -42,5 +42,11 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
             checked: root.cfg_compactDisplay == "w"
             onCheckedChanged: if (checked) root.cfg_compactDisplay = "w"
         }
+        QtControls.RadioButton {
+            text: i18nc("Show the date as text (eg. November 26, 2026) instead of the calendar icon", "Show date as text")
+
+            checked: root.cfg_compactDisplay == "text"
+            onCheckedChanged: if (checked) root.cfg_compactDisplay = "text"
+        }
     }
 }
diff --git a/applets/calendar/qml/main.qml b/applets/calendar/qml/main.qml
index c536afd1ca..f58ea3a903 100644
--- a/applets/calendar/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/calendar/qml/main.qml
@@ -11,6 +11,7 @@ import QtQuick
 import QtQuick.Layouts
 
 import org.kde.plasma.plasmoid
+import org.kde.plasma.core as PlasmaCore
 import org.kde.plasma.clock
 import org.kde.plasma.components as PlasmaComponents3
 import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
@@ -23,8 +24,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
     switchWidth: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 12
     switchHeight: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 12
 
-    toolTipMainText: Qt.formatDate(clockSource.dateTime, "dddd")
-    toolTipSubText: {
+    readonly property string dateWithoutWeekday: {
         // this logic is taken from digital-clock:
         // remove "dddd" from the locale format string
         // /all/ locales in LongFormat have "dddd" either
@@ -35,6 +35,9 @@ PlasmoidItem {
         return Qt.formatDate(clockSource.dateTime, format)
     }
 
+    toolTipMainText: Qt.formatDate(clockSource.dateTime, "dddd")
+    toolTipSubText: dateWithoutWeekday
+
     Layout.minimumWidth: Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.large
     Layout.minimumHeight: Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.large
 
@@ -46,10 +49,40 @@ PlasmoidItem {
     // generic way to overlay something on top of the icon.
     // TODO remove once it gains that feature.
     compactRepresentation: MouseArea {
+        readonly property bool showDateText: Plasmoid.configuration.compactDisplay === "text"
+        readonly property bool horizontal: Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Horizontal
+        readonly property bool vertical: Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Vertical
+
+        Layout.minimumWidth: showDateText && horizontal ? dateLabel.implicitWidth : 0
+        Layout.maximumWidth: showDateText && horizontal ? dateLabel.implicitWidth : Infinity
+        Layout.minimumHeight: showDateText && vertical ? dateLabel.paintedHeight : 0
+        Layout.maximumHeight: showDateText && vertical ? dateLabel.paintedHeight : Infinity
+
         onClicked: root.expanded = !root.expanded
 
+        PlasmaComponents3.Label {
+            id: dateLabel
+            anchors.left: parent.left
+            anchors.right: parent.right
+            anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
+            height: parent.vertical ? implicitHeight : parent.height
+            leftPadding: parent.horizontal ? Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing : 0
+            rightPadding: leftPadding
+            visible: parent.showDateText
+
+            horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
+            verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
+            wrapMode: parent.horizontal || parent.vertical ? Text.NoWrap : Text.WordWrap
+            fontSizeMode: parent.horizontal ? Text.FixedSize : (parent.vertical ? Text.HorizontalFit : Text.Fit)
+            minimumPointSize: Kirigami.Theme.smallFont.pointSize
+
+            text: parent.vertical ? Qt.formatDate(clockSource.dateTime, Qt.locale().dateFormat(Locale.ShortFormat)) : root.dateWithoutWeekday
+            textFormat: Text.PlainText
+        }
+
         KSvg.SvgItem {
             anchors.centerIn: parent
+            visible: !parent.showDateText
             width: Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.roundedIconSize(Math.min(parent.width, parent.height))
             height: width
 
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Calendar widget in the panel: only the icon with the day number
With "Show date as text": the panel shows "November 26, 2026"
Settings offer only day of the month or week number
New "Show date as text" choice under Compact version
Vertical panel (short date, above a widget still in icon mode) and a small desktop widget
